turns.text: how do i create an ABHA with aadhaar otp
Request an OTP with scope abha-enrol and loginHint aadhaar, then call enrol/byAadhaar with the txnId and the encrypted OTP. The response carries ABHAProfile with the ABHANumber.
ok got the number back. now how does the person pick their address

must_contain: Fetch suggestions with GET /abha/api/v3/enrollment/enrol/suggestion, sending the enrolment txnId in the TRANSACTION_ID header, and the suggestions come back in abhaAddressList.
Claim the chosen address with POST /abha/api/v3/enrollment/enrol/abha-address, sending the txnId, the abhaAddress and preferred set to 1.
An account left with only its default address is a half finished job the person will not recognise later.
